question: How much tax does Alice have to pay in 2016?
text: Alice has a brother, Bob, who was born January 31st, 2014 and has always lived at his parents' place. In 2016, Alice's gross income was $567192. Alice got married on Jan 12, 2016. Her husband had no income in 2016. Alice does not file a joint return. Alice has itemized deductions of $100206. Alice elects to itemize her deductions for 2016.
